transcript: Speaker A: अबे कब बनाओगे ये मेट्रो? मेरी बेटी हर दिन स्कूल में लेट हो जाती है सिर्फ तुम्हारी वजह से। [Hey, when will you build this metro? My daughter gets late to school every day just because of you.] Speaker B: Sir, please don't be disrespectful. We are only doing our job. Speaker A: अरे भाई, तुम तो अलग लेवल की इंग्लिश बोल रहे हो। ये कहाँ से सीखी? [Oh brother, you are speaking next-level English. Where did you learn this?] Speaker B: मुझे एक शॉर्टकट पता चल गया है सर। English Seekho ऐप से मैंने बेसिक इंग्लिश सीख ली। [I found a shortcut, sir. I learned basic English from the English Seekho app.] Speaker A: ऐप में कोई इंग्लिश कैसे सीख सकता है? [How can anyone learn English in an app?] Speaker B: ये ऐप कमाल है सर। मेरा पूरा खानदान अब इसी से सीख रहा है। सिर्फ वीडियोस ध्यान से देखनी है। [This app is amazing, sir. My whole family is learning from it now. You just have to watch the videos carefully.] Speaker A: वीडियोस देखने से बोलने का कॉन्फिडेंस थोड़ी आ जायेगा? उसके लिए प्रैक्टिस तो लगेगी ना? [Will watching videos give you the confidence to speak? You'll need practice for that, right?] Speaker B: AI के साथ प्रैक्टिस करता हूँ। गलती करने का डर ख़त्म हो जाता है। ये AI बिलकुल मज़ाक नहीं उड़ाती, बल्कि गलती को सुधारने का तरीका बताती है। [I practice with AI. The fear of making mistakes is gone. This AI doesn't make fun of you at all, instead it tells you how to correct your mistake.] Speaker A: पर ये तो महंगा होगा? कैसे मैनेज करते हो? [But this must be expensive? How do you manage?] Speaker B: बिलकुल भी महंगा नहीं है। मैंने तो 1 रुपये देके 3 दिन का ट्रायल ले लिया था। [Not expensive at all. I took a 3-day trial by paying just 1 rupee.] Speaker C: तो इंस्टॉल बटन पे क्लिक करो और English Seekho ऐप डाउनलोड करो। [So click on the install button and download the English Seekho app.]
on_screen_text: Abe kab banaoge ye metro [When will you build this metro], Meri beti har din [My daughter every day], school mein late ho jaati hai [gets late to school], sirf tumhaari wajah se [just because of you], please don't be disrespectful, We are only doing our job, Arre bhai [Oh brother], tum to alag level ki English [you speak next-level English], bol rahe ho [are speaking], Ye kaha se seekhi [Where did you learn this], Mujhe ek shortcut pata chal [I found a shortcut], gaya hai sir [sir], English Seekho app se [from English Seekho app], maine basic English seekh li [I learned basic English], App mein koi English [How can anyone in the app], kaise seekh sakta hai [learn English], Ye app kamaal hai sir [This app is amazing sir], Mera poora khaandan [My whole family], ab isi se seekh rahe hai [is learning from this now], Sirf videos dhyaan se dekhni hai [Just have to watch videos carefully], Videos dekhne se [By watching videos], bolne ka confidence [confidence to speak], thodi ho jayega [won't just come], Uske liye practice to lagegi na [You will need practice for that, right], AI ke saath practice [Practice with AI], karta hu [I do], galti karne ka darr [fear of making mistakes], khatam ho jata hai [is gone], Ye AI bilkul mazaak nahi udaati [This AI doesn't make fun at all], balki galati ko sudhaarne [instead to correct the mistake], ka tareeka bataati hai [shows the way], Par ye to mehenga hoga [But this must be expensive], Kaise manage karte ho [How do you manage], Bilkul bhi mehenga nahi hai [Not expensive at all], Maine to 1 rupaye de ke [I paid 1 rupee], 3 din ka trial le liya tha [and took a 3-day trial], English Seekho, INSTALL NOW
summary: A frustrated father is surprised when a metro construction worker responds to his complaints in fluent English. The worker credits the English Seekho app, explaining how its AI feature helps him practice speaking without judgment. He encourages the father to download the app, highlighting a 3-day trial available for just 1 rupee.
